stemMarkdown: 25 workers, each working 10 hours a day, can complete a job in 7 days. How many days will 19 workers, each working 6 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 25 \times 7 \times 10$ worker-hours $= 1750$. With 19 workers at 6 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{1750}{19\times6} = 15.35$.
